entries.desc: After mutating a material source file referenced by stored evidence, koala session_brief output for B-a2f1 contains the literal string EVIDENCE STALE and a storyId-bearing recovery line
After the same mutation, koala validate --story=B-a2f1 --json textOutput contains EVIDENCE STALE marker (replacing the older generic stale hint)
After the same mutation, story_advance --phase=TEST pre-check rejects with output containing EVIDENCE STALE marker
When evidence is fresh (no materialHash drift), none of the three surfaces print EVIDENCE STALE
When only koala_metadata-only changes happened after evidence (legacy fresh case), surfaces stay quiet — they do not falsely flag stale
Surfaces never print EVIDENCE STALE without also printing a copy-paste recovery line including the actual storyId
Output below EVIDENCE STALE marker contains the literal koala verification_evidence_refresh_stale --storyId=B-a2f1 line
Same block also contains koala validate --story=B-a2f1 --json line on the following line
All three surfaces (session_brief, story_advance pre-check, koala validate) print byte-identical recovery block to avoid users having to recognize multiple formats
Output never contains the literal placeholder strings <storyId> or <B- when stale state is detected — only the actual storyId is interpolated
If story has no storyId context (edge: cross-story session_brief), the recovery block is omitted entirely rather than printing a placeholder
koala recover_evidence --storyId=B-a2f1 runs verification_evidence_refresh_stale then validate, prints both transcripts in order, exits 0 when validate passes
recover_evidence exits non-zero with a refused message when material_source_changes / fixture_changes / unexpected_dirty_files exist (uses B-6326 DIRTY_WORKTREE_CATEGORIES classifier)
recover_evidence proceeds normally when only koala_metadata_changes / runtime_artifact_changes / declared_artifact_changes are present in worktree
recover_evidence refuse-list uses an allowlist (koala_metadata + runtime + declared_artifact) so any future DIRTY_WORKTREE_CATEGORIES addition defaults to refuse — no silent loosening
recover_evidence does not auto-recover without storyId; missing storyId arg returns explicit error

Smoke fixture mutates a tracked material source path under a temp worktree, writes evidence with stale materialHash, asserts session_brief / story_advance / validate all produce EVIDENCE STALE marker with copy-paste storyId line
Smoke runs recover_evidence and asserts second validate is fresh + passes
Smoke adds an unexpected_dirty_files path (e.g. packages/main/tests/output/x.json) to the same worktree and asserts recover_evidence refuses with non-zero exit and refused message
Smoke confirms surfaces produce byte-identical EVIDENCE STALE block (same marker, same recovery block) across session_brief / story_advance / validate
Smoke confirms recovery block never contains placeholder text when storyId is present
